# netactuate_bgp_asns (Data Source)

Reads BGP Asns visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_bgp_asns" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_type` (String) BGP group type filter. The API defaults this to anycast when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `asns` (List of Object) BGP ASNs visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asns))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--asns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asns`

Read-Only:

- `asn` (Number)
- `bgp_asn_id` (Number)
- `group_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
